text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Change in error from adding one set of columns (or one training choice) to weather + hour and weekday. 13 primary substations, validation year 2024-07 to 2025-06, one XGBoost model per substation trained on ERA5 weather (ECMWF's estimate of past weather). Dot: estimate, one fitting seed. Line: 95% interval from re-drawing whole months. Rule: no change.'
text.tspan: Change in error from adding one set of columns (or one training choice) to weather + hour and weekday. 13 primary
substations, validation year 2024-07 to 2025-06, one XGBoost model per substation trained on ERA5 weather (ECMWF's
estimate of past weather). Dot: estimate, one fitting seed. Line: 95% interval from re-drawing whole months. Rule: no
